figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(labor_cents) labor,SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes) minutes_worked FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(b.labor,0) labor_cents,ROUND(1.0*COALESCE(b.minutes_worked,0)/60,2) worked_hours,ROUND(60.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.minutes_worked,0),2) sales_per_hour_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(b.labor,0)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) labor_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC
